text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmrrrrrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you dummy! 
You two-timer~~~!
choice_data_list: Wh-What?! What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
'Cause you've been practicing the Hikoma 
with Blast-chan the eeeentire time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You didn't come to Maya's practice at all! 
Even though you're supposed to be Maya's 
Trainer!
choice_data_list:
S-Sorry. I needed to practice my role as 
Tsunade...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I know. 
I know that, but stillll~! Hmph, hmph!
choice_data_list:
Of course I'll help you practice too, 
Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, keep your eyes on me, okay? Maya's 
dance is gonna 
completely enchant you, Trainer☆

It was an expressive, vibrant dance that 
was unmistakably Mayano Top Gun. 
Just watching it filled me with energy. 
To my astonishment, she didn't make a 
single mistake!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how was it? 
Maya's dance!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right?! 
Maya worked super hard!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So you know what that means—gimme a 
reward♪ C'mooon!

Her usual wheedling. 
Her dance truly had been marvelous. 
And besides...

Ever since her debut race, her spirits had 
mysteriously seemed low, which worried me. 
Maybe a motivation boost was just what she 
needed.
choice_data_list:
Alright. I'll think of a good reward for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't wait for today~. A day-trip 
date♪ 
Hey, hey, where are you taking me?
choice_data_list:
Somewhere you can see real professional 
dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Dancing? 
Aww, so it's just for the ceremonial dance 
practice~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, a date's a date! 
Be a good escort for me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That soft serve looks so cuuute! 
Look, look, it's covered in colorful 
little pom-poms!
choice_data_list: Ah, could that be oiri soft serve?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that line! It's super 
popular! 
Well, we simply haaave to try it, right?
choice_data_list: Haha, alright, let's stop by and get some.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! 
Ehe, I'm gonna snap a pic and brag to 
everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The dance venue is pretty far, huh? 
Plus it's uphill the whole way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-oh. Trainer, you holding up okay~? 
Wait, you don't look okay at all.
choice_data_list:
...You're full of energy as always, 
Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Because when I'm with you, Trainer, 
eeeeeverything is so much fun! 
I just get an endless fountain of energy♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Maya'll push you along! 
And then, let's cross the finish line side 
by side!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You can do it, you can do it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, the dance is... looks like it's on 
that stage over there! 
C'mon, Trainer, let's get closer to the 
front!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Are those people gonna dance? 
They look kind of ordinary to me. 
Maya was picturing someone more like 
Azuma-san.
choice_data_list: To be honest, so was I...
To be honest, so was I...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, they're starting!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...So pretty... 
The dance moves are kind of like Maya's, 
but... different?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Quiet, and graceful... but powerful too. 
Right... It's so dignified.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...That's the dance of a mature woman...

The moment the dance concluded, Mayano Top 
Gun 
suddenly performed the exact same dance 
right on the spot.
choice_data_list:
Incredible, you danced it completely 
identically!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's totally not the same.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The movements might be the same, but it's 
different! 
Maya's dance is missing something...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But... I don't know what's missing!
choice_data_list:
You don't know...? You of all people, 
Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Not having any clue how to do it... 
is actually super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad the Votive Dance isn't 
easy! 
We've got a long way to go, so mastering 
it already would be boring!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it right now, but I definitely 
will! 
I'm gonna turn it into the dance of a 
truly mature woman, just wait!

title: A Reward: Perfect Weather for an Outing☆
